caption: The drawing depicts a sculptural object consisting of a bird perched atop a stand. The bird, likely resembling a turkey or similar fowl, is primarily dark green or teal with some black shading and has a red area on its head, likely representing the beak or wattle. The bird stands on a horizontal green bar that features two white paddles or blades on each end, each marked with red stripes. This bar is affixed to a vertical post made up of a sequence of alternating diamond-shaped segments in black, white, and reddish-brown, forming a geometric pattern along its height. The stand's base is circular and decorated with a pattern of alternating red and blue diamond shapes on a white background. The drawing is bordered by a rectangular outline, and the name "JOHN FISK." appears printed at the bottom right of the inner rectangle. The colors used include shades of green, black, red, blue, and white. The background is plain and uncolored, and the paper has an off-white or beige tone.
title: Pa. German Toy Bird
